name: staging
description: The staging stand-up (tests/compositions/staging): one nested-virt VM running dev up --profile market-network, or (layout multi) four small VMs joined by one network value.

actions.label: Stand up staging
actions.description: Rent, install, dev up, dev status, dev down; the result says pass, the phase and the readings.

config.label: name
config.description: the run; the VM's invocation is <name>-vm

config.label: layout
config.description: single (default): one nested-virt VM; multi: atproto 2/4, bidder-1 and bidder-2 4/8 nested, gateway 4/8 on one meshd overlay, joined by the atproto VM's network value

config.label: suite
config.description: runbook compositions run inside the VM (default 0003 0005 0006 0007 0008 0012 0013); false: the stand-up only

config.label: bidders
config.description: dev up's bidders on the VM (default 1)

config.label: fault
config.description: status: that step fails (dev status of an instance the VM does not have), the proof of a failed run's logs/

config.label: requester
config.description: the binary installed on the VM: release:<tag> or sha:<commit> (the target's requester)
